szoveg_eredeti:
Check Point CTO Jonathan Zanger explains how his team uses OpenAI Daybreak to analyze vulnerabilities and turn findings into protections for customers. A vulnerability research workflow that once took hours can now be completed in minutes, according to Zanger.

Watch the full video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vVVdxMwPBuA

Read the full customer story: https://openai.com/index/check-point-daybreak/
